posts.text: 2/2: Novelty aside, the point of my post was to explain why this is also legally incoherent. Separate from a "precedential stay" with no precedent, there is no colorable argument that the government both (1) meets the criteria for *any* emergency relief at this juncture; and (2) didn't *until* now.
